text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Take thaaat! 
My win~♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san, Teio-chan. 
The tea is ready, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You've really been absorbed in that "game" of yours. 
Haven't you been at it since morning?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Things just got super heated! 
Tran is crazy good at it, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's nice to see you having fun. 
Still, moderation is key for everything, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okaayy――

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Young Mistress, shall we wrap up the game and head outside? 
After all, moderation is best in all things.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Teio-chan? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah――ehehe. 
It kinda just reminded me of gramps, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oho...? Well, Accu-san definitely has that distinct grandma vibe, for sure.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You mean him, right? That butler guy at your place, Teio-chan. 
What's he like?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmm, he's always taking care of me and playing with me a bunch, like a real grandpa!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, 
he's always, always been by my side――

text_block_list.name: Young Teio
text_block_list.text:
What?! Papa and Mama have to work?! 
You said we were going out today, you liars! 
Uwaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text: Young Mistress, will you bear with this old man for today? I shall keep you company to your heart's content, so let us play together.

text_block_list.name: Young Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Really? 
Then I wanna explore the garden. I wanna eat lots of snacks, and play lots of games too!

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. I shall gladly accompany you. 
I will always remain right by your side.

text_block_list.name: Young Teio
text_block_list.text:
――! Yay! 
Then exploring comes first! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Young Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gramps, let's play tag! 
You're It! Ready, set, go!!

text_block_list.name: Young Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry! 
It won't end unless you catch meee!

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Y-Young Mistress...! *pant*, *pant*...! 
Please, have mercy on this old man...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Wait, you went all-out playing tag against an elderly human grandpa? That's reckless violence right there!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, come on, I was just a little kid back then! 
Call it cute mischievousness! 
Besides, he was like――

text_block_list.name: Young Teio
text_block_list.text:
This chair is MIIINE too! This hanging scroll is too! 
I'm writing my name on it~ "M" "I" "N" "E"! 
Look look, gramps! This is mine!

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Young Miiiiiistress! How many times must I tell you to stop writing "Mine" on everything...! 
At least refrain from using permanent markers...!

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! Not that vase, anything but that...! 
The Master will weep...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...So yeah, he could be a teensy bit nagging sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Pfffft――!! 
Ahaha... Ahahaha...! Th-That's brutal...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My, oh my... You certainly were quite the handful, weren't you, Teio-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That was strictly when I was little! 
I'm totally different now... probably!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Besides, there were times when I went out of my way to do nice things for him too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Like preparing a gyokuro green tea bath so he could refresh himself and relax!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Well, turns out those gyokuro tea leaves were his prized, super precious stash, so he ended up crying afterwards, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Those tears... yeah, he definitely shed plenty of 'em...! 
Tears of pure blood, that is... Hehe, man... what a disaster...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. But even with all the trouble, I'm sure he couldn't help but find you utterly adorable.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It sounds like you two share a bond just like a real grandfather and granddaughter.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Totally! We live apart right now, but he's always thinking of me, so he really is just like a real grandpa!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, seriously.
Pops sure looks busy in real time right now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You should do something nice for him once in a while.
Like showing some grandpa filial piety or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Grandpa filial piety...
Yeah, that might be awesome!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: After all, I want Pops to stay healthy forever and keep being my "Pops"!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you're gonna go on an outing just the two of you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'm still figuring out the plan though.
I'm gonna treat Pops to the best day ever~!
Hearing that heartwarming conversation unfold one afternoon brought an involuntary smile to my face.
